intent: Bind full-stack and product-facing UI evidence to a closed review contract, preserve human judgment, and deny the verifier release authority.
assumptions: Authentication identity is not assumed from local reviewer metadata; consequential release decisions require the repository's trusted approval and receipt path.
Native tool availability is not assumed: legacy verify consumes evidence; optional visual execution requires an explicit pinned fixture contract and --execute.
coherence_basis: Owner requested optional optical/Prestige integration. SpecLine strict and all15 requirement mutations passed before implementation; final Forge/browser/workflow evidence remains required. Not product certification or measured outcome proof.
